items.originalTitle: Horner to Ferrari rumours: What's really going on
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner's interview comments calling Ferrari the biggest brand in Formula 1 and a dream destination have fuelled speculation about a move, but sources told The Race this is not quite the case.
keyPointsZh: 该采访是在9月初意大利大奖赛之前、通过出版社为霍纳下月发行的新书做的宣传，并非他公开自荐。
霍纳与法拉利主席约翰·埃尔坎长期保持联系，2022年夏埃尔坎曾到其家中邀请他出任领队，但双方从未讨论过在马拉内罗任职的事。
霍纳此前对执教法拉利一直心存顾虑，且瓦塞尔的去留在意大利大奖赛前后再度引发传闻。
keyPointsEn: The interview was arranged through the publisher as promotion for Horner's upcoming book and took place before the Italian Grand Prix in early September.

Horner has long been in regular contact with Ferrari chairman John Elkann, who visited his house in the summer of 2022 to offer him the team principal job before it went to Vasseur, but there have been no discussions about a role at Maranello.
The interview happened when rumours resurfaced about Fred Vasseur's future at Ferrari, and Horner has long held reservations about taking the job.

items.originalTitle: Vasseur responds after Horner's 'dream' Ferrari job comments
items.summaryEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur admits the team cannot work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened by Christian Horner's comments about Formula 1's "dream" job.
detailZh: 法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，克里斯蒂安·霍纳是在“找工作”，这加剧了围绕这支F1车队的令人“沮丧”的猜测。
前红牛高层克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，法拉利是唯一一支他会在不持有股权的情况下考虑重返F1的车队；天空体育F1将从周五上午起直播F1重返马来西亚的比赛，雪邦赛道将承办巴林大奖赛。
雅克·维伦纽夫在霍纳称法拉利是F1中“梦幻”车队之后，就其加盟法拉利的可能性发表了看法。
弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔承认，在关于他未来的持续猜测中，法拉利无法在“完美的安宁”中工作，而克里斯蒂安·霍纳关于F1“梦幻”职位的言论进一步加剧了这种猜测。
瓦塞尔于2023年从索伯加盟法拉利担任车队领队，在经历糟糕的2025年之后，他见证了车队今年重回争冠行列，但近几个月来，他们向梅赛德斯发起的世界冠军挑战逐渐消退，因为在连续五场比赛中未能登上领奖台。
在上周接受《泰晤士报》的采访中，前红牛车队领队霍纳表示，法拉利是他唯一愿意在不持有股权的情况下重返指挥墙的车队，而股权一直是他对任何回归这项运动的优先考虑条件。

在周日阿塞拜疆大奖赛（他的两名车手分别获得第四名和第六名）之后，当被问及近期围绕他和车队的外界噪音是否对他们造成影响时，瓦塞尔承认这确实令人沮丧。
"我们的工作环境并不算完全平静，"瓦塞尔说道。
"对我来说，首先是如此，对车队里的每个人、对媒体、对这些占了一半的问题来说，也是如此。我觉得这是一个有点令人沮丧的局面。
"我们正在为锦标赛第二名的争夺而战。但到头来，我们大家都在不停地谈论这件事，甚至车库里的技师们也在讨论它，这并不是我们所能拥有的最好的讨论。
"但事情就是这样，这不在我掌握之中。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳在今年英国大奖赛回到围场时接受了天空体育记者克雷格·斯莱特的采访。
提及他在红牛的前任 对应职位者霍纳时，瓦塞尔补充道："霍纳先生正在找工作。所有人都知道，到处都知道。"
"我能做什么？我只是尽力推动车队，要求车队保持斗志，专注于今天什么才是最有利的，而不是把时间花在八卦上。"
"每场采访里，这种问题一天要出现25次。"
2026年阿塞拜疆大奖赛的精彩集锦。
瓦塞尔去年签署了多年的续约合同，并表示自己对这个职位的投入毋庸置疑，他正努力带领F1最著名的车队重回世界冠军的轨道，这是车队自2008年以来从未再染指的荣耀。
“当然。这项运动就是我的生命，也是我的事业，”58岁的瓦塞尔说。“我在尽自己最大的努力。当然，我在这里就是为了做好我的工作。我拥有世界上最好的工作。”
“事情就是这样。我们还有七场比赛要打，我们会拼到最后一个弯角。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿将瓦塞尔的存在列为他2025年从梅赛德斯转投法拉利的一个重要原因，两人曾在青训系列赛事中合作过。巴库大奖赛结束后，当天空体育F1问这位七届世界冠军，在瓦塞尔掌舵下车队是否仍处于良好的前进轨道上时，他回答“是的”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿回顾了他的阿塞拜疆大奖赛，本站他获得第六名。
维伦纽夫：霍纳是必须纳入考虑的人选
早在2025年7月被红牛解雇之前，多年来霍纳就时常与法拉利传出绯闻，原因是他曾带领红牛这支车队的竞争对手赢得八次车手世界冠军和六次车队世界冠军的辉煌成就。
天空体育F1评论员雅克·维伦纽夫认为，霍纳目前处于可引进状态，任何车队都必须将他纳入考虑。
“克里斯蒂安·霍纳是一个你必须认真对待并加以考虑的人，因为他打造了那支常胜的红牛车队。”这位1997年的世界冠军在巴库接受天空体育新闻采访时说。
“他身上有很多非常优秀且积极的履历，充满成功，所以你必须把这一点纳入考量。”
天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特回顾了克里斯蒂安·霍纳担任红牛首席执行官兼车队领队的20年历程。
“我不会说这对现任者来说很可怕，但你必须时刻保持警惕。”
瓦塞尔在2023赛季初从外部被聘请过来，成为法拉利九年内第五任车队领队，目前这个赛季是他在任的第四年。
维伦纽夫补充道：“法拉利不是一个容易待的地方。我们已经见过太多变动——干个两三年，然后就换下一个人，因为成绩出不来。
“所以你随时都坐在一个可以弹射出去的座位上，必须小心谨慎。”

detailEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur says Christian Horner 'looking for a job' adding to 'frustrating' speculation around F1 team

Ex-Red Bull chief Christian Horner said Ferrari would be the only team he would consider coming back to F1 for without an ownership stake; watch Formula 1's return to Malaysia from Friday morning live on Sky Sports F1 as Sepang hosts the Bahrain Grand Prix
Jacques Villeneuve comments on the likelihood of Christian Horner joining Ferrari following his comments the team is 'the dream' in F1.

Frederic Vasseur admits Ferrari are not able to work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened after comments from Christian Horner about Formula 1's "dream" job.

Vasseur, who joined Ferrari as team principal from Sauber in 2023, has an overseen their return to race-winning ways this year after a poor 2025 but their world championship challenge to Mercedes has faded in recent months amid a five-race run without a podium finish.

In an interview with The Times published last week, former Red Bull team principal Horner said Ferrari were the only team he would consider returning to the pit-wall for without the ownership stake that he has been prioritising for any comeback to the sport.

Asked after Sunday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, in which his drivers finished fourth and sixth, whether the external noise around him and the team recently was affecting them, Vasseur conceded it was frustrating.
"We are not working in perfect serenity," said Vasseur.
"For me, first, but for everybody in the team, for the media, for the 50 per cent of the questions about this. I think it's a bit of a frustrating situation.

"We are fighting for P2 in the championship. At the end of the day, we are all speaking a lot about this, and even for the guys in the garage to discuss about this, it's not the best discussion that we can have.
"But it is what it is, it's not in my hands."
Christian Horner spoke to Craig Slater when he returned to the paddock at this year's British Grand Prix.
Referencing his former Red Bull counterpart, Vasseur added: "Mr Horner is looking for a job. Everybody knows, everywhere.
"What can I do? I just try to do my best to push the team, to ask the team to be motivated, focus on what is better today, and not to spend time with gossips.
"In each interview, it will be 25 times a day."
Highlights from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Vasseur signed a multi-year contract extension last year and said there was no doubt about his commitment to the role as he bids to lead F1's most-famous team back to world title-winning ways for the first time since 2008.
"For sure. The sport is my life, it's my business," said the 58-year-old Vasseur. "I'm trying to do my best. For sure, I'm there to do my job. I have the best job in the world.
"It is like it is. We still have seven races to go and we will push to the last corner."

Lewis Hamilton credited the presence of Vasseur, who he worked with in junior series, as a central reason for him joining Ferrari from Mercedes in 2025. The seven-time world champion replied "yes" when asked by Sky Sports F1 after the Baku race whether the team remained on a good path forward with Vasseur at the helm.
Lewis Hamilton reflects on his Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which saw him finish sixth.
Villeneuve: Horner someone you must have under consideration

Even before he was sacked by Red Bull in July 2025, Horner had been intermittently linked with Ferrari over the years owing to the success which saw the Briton lead their rivals to eight drivers' and six constructors' world titles.
Sky Sports F1 pundit Jacques Villeneuve believes Horner's availability has to be a consideration for a team.
"Christian Horner is someone you have to take seriously and under consideration because he built up the winning Red Bull team," the 1997 world champion told Sky Sports News in Baku.
"He has a lot of very good and positive baggage, full of successes so you have to take that into consideration.
Sky Sports' Craig Slater takes a look back at Christian Horner's 20-year run as Red Bull CEO and team principal.
"I wouldn't say it's scary for who is in place, but you need to be on your toes."
Vasseur became Ferrari's fifth team principal in nine years when he was hired from the start of the 2023 season, with the current campaign his fourth in charge.
Villeneuve added: "Ferrari is not an easy place to be. We have seen so many changes - two or three years, next one, because the results don't come.
"So you are always on an ejectable seat and you have to be careful."

detailZh: 林布拉德就巴库与小红牛队友相撞事件道歉
小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林布拉德就阿塞拜疆大奖赛中与队友利亚姆·劳森的相撞事件道歉
小红牛一级方程式新秀阿尔维德·林布拉德在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中与队友利亚姆·劳森相撞后，已向其公开道歉。
这位英国车手在巴库城市赛道以第七名完赛，拿到六个积分，但比赛中他与队友劳森的相撞令成绩蒙上阴影。
在威廉姆斯车队的阿尔本撞车引发安全车重启时，林德布拉德比他的队友以及前方哈斯车队的奥康都刹车更晚，而那两辆车都在他的前面。最终他被夹在两辆车之间，并与劳森发生了碰撞。
劳森因此打转，最终以第12名完赛，无缘积分区。赛会干事对此事件进行了审查，认为无需进一步处罚，理由是“林德布拉德可用的空间有限”。
比赛结束后，林德布拉德在社交媒体上承担了这起事故的责任，同时也称赞了车队动力单元的表现。
“今天是一场强势的比赛，非常高兴能以第7名完赛，”他在 Instagram 故事中写道，“这一周并不轻松，我对自己在某些环节的处理感到沮丧。
阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛（小红牛）；利亚姆·劳森，小红牛（小红牛）
“我们车队整体也一直很挣扎，所以我对我们能够反弹，并在这个艰难的周末里把今天的机会发挥到极致，感到非常高兴。特别要感谢动力单元的伙计们——你们今天给了我一台绝对的火箭引擎。”
“对利亚姆发生的事感到很难受——抱歉了兄弟。很高兴我们仍然能为车队带回一些积分。”
赛后第一时间接受天空体育F1采访时，劳森透露这次碰撞让他的赛车底板破了一个洞。他解释说：“我需要看一下回放，我的意思是，在重新发车时大家都进入一号弯，我从左侧被狠狠撞了一下，底板也被撞出了一个洞。”
“所以我真不知道他当时想要留出多大的空间。我们俩同时进入一号弯的时候，我就是搞不明白。”
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad issues apology after Racing Bulls team-mate clash in Baku
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad apologised to team-mate Liam Lawson after their Azerbaijan Grand Prix collision
Racing Bulls Formula 1 rookie Arvid Lindblad has issued a public apology to his team-mate Liam Lawson following their collision during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
The British driver secured six points with a seventh-place finish around the Baku City Circuit, but the race was marred when he collided with his team-mate Lawson.

During a safety car restart after Williams' Alex Albon crashed, Lindblad braked later than his team-mate and Haas' Esteban Ocon, who were both ahead of him. He ended up becoming sandwiched between the two cars and making contact with Lawson.

Lawson was sent into a spin and ultimately finished outside the points in 12th. The incident was reviewed by the stewards, who deemed that no further action was necessary because of "the restricted space available to [Lindblad]".
Following the race, Lindblad took to social media to take responsibility for the incident, while also praising the team's power unit performance.
"Strong race today, really happy to bring it home in P7," he wrote on his Instagram story. "It’s not been an easy week, and I’m frustrated with how I handled some of it.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls
"We’ve struggled as a team too, so I’m really happy with how we bounced back and maximised today on a difficult weekend. Big shoutout to the PU boys - you gave me an absolute rocketship today.
"Gutted about what happened with Liam - sorry mate. Glad we were still able to bring some points home for the team."

Speaking to Sky Sports F1 immediately after the race, Lawson revealed the collision left a hole in his floor. "I need to watch it, but I mean, we're all coming into Turn 1 on the restart, and I just got smoked from my left, put a hole in my floor as well," he explained.
"So I don't really know what gap he was looking for. In the middle of both of us going into Turn 1, I just don't understand it."

items.originalTitle: Oscar Piastri: Error that cost me F1 Azerbaijan GP podium was "a bit weird"
items.summaryEn: McLaren Formula 1 driver Oscar Piastri described his late-race mistake at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as "a bit weird" after losing a potential podium finish in Baku.
detailZh: 皮亚斯特里：让我错失F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛领奖台的失误"有点奇怪"
一次大规模锁死让皮亚斯特里失去了在阿塞拜疆登上领奖台的机会，而他自己也说不清楚原因
皮亚斯特里、迈凯伦、伊萨克·哈贾尔、红牛车队
迈凯伦F1车手皮亚斯特里将自己在阿塞拜疆大奖赛末段的失误形容为"有点奇怪"，此前他在巴库丢掉了领奖台位置。
第二次安全车重启后，皮亚斯特里排在第三位，而在第一次重启时被维斯塔潘超越之后，他又受到了红牛车手哈贾尔的施压。
这位澳大利亚车手试图在一号弯内侧防守，结果前轮严重抱死直冲出弯，从第三位跌至第十五位——也就是密集车阵中的倒数第二位。
皮亚斯特里表示：“我需要检查一下，因为像那样瞬间两个前轮同时抱死有点奇怪。我不觉得我做了什么特别出格的操作。显然我在防守时走了和平时不同的线路，所以我不知道是不是压到了路面上的拱顶或者什么，但这对我来说确实非常意外。”
“一旦维斯塔潘跑到前面，我就不可能再反超回去了，但看看我能否守住哈贾尔在身后还是挺有意思的。说实话，那可能也会很艰难。在中性胎上很难判断，因为轮胎抱死造成的平斑相当严重，但我感觉用中性胎的状态远不如用软胎时好。”
“我认为我们本来有可能拿到第四名。不过，说‘我们本来有可能’是一回事，实际最终完赛的位置又是另一回事。”
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
皮亚斯特里整个赛季都在与2026年规格的F1赛车苦苦抗争，这是众所周知的，但这一次在巴库他的表现超过了队友兰多·诺里斯；这位25岁的车手以第三名追平了他本赛季最好的排位赛成绩，并且本有可能拿下自迈阿密以来的首个领奖台完赛成绩。
“总体来说，我不一定会说自己更适应了，但我能从赛车中榨出更多的圈速，”他解释道。“尤其是在驾驶方式上，我已经能够弄清楚自己需要往哪个方向去努力了。”
“除了比赛中的一段时刻，我感觉这个周末的表现已经更接近我对自己期望的水平了。从这方面来说，这让人振奋得多。只是很明显，目前还没有任何成绩可以展示，这还是挺让人痛苦的。”
那么皮亚斯特里在驾驶方面到底需要往哪个方向改进呢？
“之前的赛车，尤其是在正赛中，你要以99%的状态去驾驶，”他解释道，“你必须稍微照顾一下轮胎，而以99%的状态驾驶是最快的方式。
“开这些赛车，感觉你必须一直保持在101%的状态，一旦达不到，圈速就会大幅流失。这就是为什么我说这个周末并不一定更舒服，但我能更容易地达到那个101%或100%的状态。”
“我感觉这个周末我确实学到了一些有意思的东西，可以带回去继续运用，但这仍然是一个学习的过程。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri: Error that cost me F1 Azerbaijan GP podium was "a bit weird"
A massive lock-up meant Oscar Piastri lost a potential podium finish in Azerbaijan, and he couldn’t quite explain it
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
McLaren Formula 1 driver Oscar Piastri has labelled his late-race Azerbaijan Grand Prix mistake as “a bit weird”, after losing the podium in Baku.
Piastri was running third following the second safety-car restart and came under pressure from Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar after being overtaken by Max Verstappen at the first restart.
Attempting to defend on the inside in Turn 1, the Australian had an enormous lock-up and went straight on, collapsing from third to 15th – the penultimate position in the bunched-up pack.

“I need to look, because it was a bit weird just locking up both fronts instantly like that,” Piastri commented. “I didn't think I did anything spectacular. Obviously I was on a different line to what I normally would be, defending. So I don't know if I was on a crown in the road or something, but it certainly was a surprise to me.

“Once Max got ahead, I was never going to get back past, but it would have been interesting to see if I could keep Hadjar behind. To be honest, it probably would have been tough. It's hard to tell on the medium because they were pretty heavily flat-spotted, but I didn't feel anywhere near as good on the medium as I did on the soft.
“I think potentially we could have been P4. One thing is saying ‘we could have been’, and one thing is where you actually finish.”
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Piastri has notoriously been struggling all season with F1’s 2026-spec machinery, but for once he outperformed team-mate Lando Norris in Baku; the 25-year-old equalled his best qualifying result of the season with third place, and could have taken his first podium finish since Miami.

“In general, I wouldn't necessarily say I've been more comfortable, but I've been able to get more lap time out of the car,” he explained. “I've been able to understand which direction I need to go in with my driving especially.

“Apart from one moment in the race, I feel like it's been a weekend much more at the level I expect from myself. From that side of things, it's been much more encouraging. Just, obviously, it's pretty painful to not have anything to show for it yet.”
So what direction did Piastri need to go in with his driving, exactly?
“The previous cars, especially in the race, you drove at 99%,” he explained. “You had to look after the tyres a little bit, and driving at 99% was the fastest way to drive.

“With these cars, it feels like you have to be at 101% all the time, and as soon as you can't be, then you just haemorrhage lap time. That's why I say it's not necessarily been more comfortable this weekend, but I've been able to get to that 101% or 100% a bit easier.
“I feel like I've definitely learned some interesting things this weekend to take forward, but it's still a learning process.”
